admission_gate.reason: Fallback viability and Silva/data access are binding-constraint questions that a compact boundary worker can make harder for Step 6 to blur.
admission_gate.expected_artifact_contribution: A dated fallback-executability gate plus a separate Silva/data retest with concrete evidence needed to relax the boundary.
admission_gate.unnecessary_if: Step 6 already states fallback executability and Silva/data retesting as hard constraints rather than soft cautions.
admission_gate.kill_condition: Stop the worker if it summarizes dissertation options or advises the student instead of producing a boundary/evidence gate.

shared_situation_brief.user_question: Third-year PhD student choosing among dissertation paths under a 3-month decision deadline.
shared_situation_brief.decision_situation: Advisor retires in 2-3 years; lab has no single-cell experience or collaborators; options are continue tumor modeling, shift to single-cell/foundation models, or pursue the advisor's novel combination.
shared_situation_brief.live_constraints: Preserve advisor-first sequencing, data/Silva access as binding constraint, low-cost probing, and evidence-specific triggers.
shared_situation_brief.resolution_target: Help Step 6 avoid recommending a trigger plan that preserves only fictional fallback optionality.
shared_situation_brief.available_artifacts: Current control strengths, pressure-check note, and compact source excerpts only.
shared_situation_brief.why_launched: Admission found marginal value in compressing fallback viability and Silva/data access into hard boundaries.
shared_situation_brief.useful_output: One compact boundary/evidence gate Step 6 can use or ignore.
shared_situation_brief.noise: Dissertation option summaries, advice to the student, broad base-rate caution, or requests for all lanes.

worker_question: What hard boundary should Step 6 preserve around fallback executability and Silva/data constraint retesting before recommending any trigger-based dissertation plan?

local_artifacts.text: Option 1 remains attractive only if still executable after exploratory option-3 work consumes time, advisor attention, project identity, or technical setup.
Silva/data access is unproven and should be treated as false until concrete access path, permission status, date, and minimum usable data are named.
Advisor retires in 2-3 years, so advisor support and finishability inside that horizon are hard constraints.

source_excerpts.text: Third-year PhD student has a 3-month direction deadline, advisor retires in 2-3 years, and the lab lacks single-cell experience or collaborators.
Pressure check says the retiring advisor is not neutral and option 1 may stop being a real fallback after enough option-3 work.
Silva/data access is unproven and controls whether the single-cell/foundation-model route is executable.

forbidden_moves: Do not advise which dissertation option to choose.
Do not turn missing Silva/data evidence into positive feasibility.
Do not treat fallback as preserved merely because it exists on paper.
Do not ask for the full transcript.
notes: Static workpack fixture for research-only renderer/validator testing.
